result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B keeps the scope to the stretch from referral to booking the second visit and explains why. It shows a draft blueprint with front desk and therapist rows, labels each cell as a guess, and gives a week-by-week plan that fits the clinic's staff. A has sound research steps and a useful note about the deadline, but its map runs all the way to discharge, which undercuts its own advice to narrow the scope, and its plan is less tightly scheduled. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A keeps the scope tightly on the stretch from referral to booking the second visit and explains why. It gives a concrete draft map with backstage rows for the front desk and therapist, clearly labelled as guesswork, and a week-by-week plan that fits their resources. B has strong research advice and usefully points out that the end of the month may be only days away, but its map runs through to discharge and its focus on clinic-specific moments is less sharp.
